Only Test No.1-No.7 are evaluated; Test No.8-No.15 are omitted.
Changed condition incorrectly includes Standard as a test condition.
Outcome metric is the table title, not NG count, NG rate, or defect mode results.

requiredUserQuestions: Confirm whether Test No.1-No.5 and Test No.6-No.15 are separate on/off delay sweeps.
correctionPlan: Redefine the primary factor as DOE laser delay setting with Value and GAP levels.
Use Standard row as baseline and include all Test No.1-No.15 rows.
Separate or annotate on-delay/off-delay sweeps if confirmed by source context.
Set outcomes to Cutting offset NG, Not cut all NG, Total NG, and NG rate.
Cite header rows plus every compared data row.
